## Nitro — first release 🚀

Adds Lossless Scaling's frame generation to 64-bit **DirectX 9, 10, 11, 12, OpenGL and Vulkan** single-player games at **2x, 3x or 4x**, or in **Dynamic** mode, which tops your frame rate up to your monitor's refresh rate. It runs inside the game's own rendering, so there's no window capture and no overlay.

### Install
1. Download **Nitro-x64.zip** below and unzip it anywhere.
2. Run `Nitro.exe`. The first-run setup finds [Lossless Scaling](https://store.steampowered.com/app/993090/Lossless_Scaling/) on your PC (you need to own it) and builds its frame-gen shaders into Nitro.
3. Pick your game's `.exe`, choose a multiplier and click **Install into game**. The graphics API is detected automatically.
4. Start the game. Press **Insert** for the Nitro menu, **End** to toggle frame gen and **Home** to cycle 2x/3x/4x.

### Heads-up
- This is an early **pre-release** and hasn't been tested on many games yet. If something breaks, open an issue and attach `Nitro.log` from the game folder.
- Single-player games only. Don't use it with anything that has anti-cheat.
- Not affiliated with Lossless Scaling or its developer.
